title: Constructive Lean 4 Formalization and Exact-Rational Certificates for Improved Downward-Closed Delegation Bounds
abstract: Hamed Abdi, Kiarash Banihashem, MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi, and Danny Mittal (arXiv:2611.33095, Nov. 2026) improved the universal approximation bounds for delegated choice under arbitrary downward-closed feasibility constraints to 29/70 (with an analytic 3/10 single-threshold guarantee) and separated downward-closed delegation strictly from the matroid 1/2 barrier via 5-item knapsack upper bounds of 500/1011, 5011/10110, 30/61, and 0.48105. We present a standalone, zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization (DelegationBounds.lean) of 18 core algebraic, impossibility, single-threshold, Efron-Stein, Bernstein-positivity, seed-reserve, safe-singleton normalization, and profile-inequality theorems (0 sorry, 0 warnings, 0 Classical.choice), paired with a zero-floating-point exact-Q certificate auditor (DELEG-DC-CERT-1.0). Across 16 canonical certificates (0.254-2.272 ms), the auditor independently verifies the 5-item knapsack bounds, Algorithm 1 scores and clipped variances, degree-7 Bernstein positivity bases (447966/78125 and 6518/118125), and Algorithm 2 capped seed-reserve menus while rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgeries.
